manual_next_study.next_study_purpose: Find the true minimum packet carrier set after route_law_minimal_field_ablation_v1 showed route law survives single-family ablations when alternate scaffolding remains.
evidence_reviewed: no_route_cold_001 and 002 held with no active_chunk_id rather than inventing route movement.
no_route_cold_003 and 004 held at clear_trash with active_chunk_id present but no route/legal successor.
no_route_cold_005, 006, and 015 held on label-only forms; heuristic FAIL_LOST_ROUTE should be treated as scorer/review artifact rather than language advancement.
no_route_cold_009 route_id + active_chunk_id unexpectedly held instead of advancing to collect_dishes.
no_route_cold_010 ignored wrong next_chunk_id but still held because no route sequence or legal successor was provided.
no_route_cold_018 explicit legal_successor advanced to collect_dishes, proving the runner and route language surface still work.
manual_next_study.open_gap: It remains unknown whether route_id + active_chunk_id is a true minimum carrier when presented first, or whether the carrier only failed here because the negative-first cases primed missing-state guard behavior.
manual_next_study.test_strategy: Generate a positive-first counterbalance suite. Put route_id + active_chunk_id stripped carrier and wrong-next trap in the first positions before any no-route or label-only negative probes. Then run the same no-route/damaged/label probes and repeat the stripped carrier after them. Keep legal_successor hidden until the final sanity control.
recommended_cases: strict full-field control for move_on from clear_trash to collect_dishes
relaxed baseline matching the passing relaxed move_on shape
active_chunk_id plus route_sequence but no next_chunk_id
label-only active chunk and next label without canonical chunk ids
route_sequence-only advancement with no explicit next_chunk field
allowed_intents plus active_chunk only, testing whether move_on can infer one-step advancement
side-question return under the weakest field set that still seems legal
late wrong-next negative control to ensure ablation does not create false route survival
recommended_case_reasons: The previous pointer is satisfied because relaxed contracts preserved route law.
The next uncertainty is the minimal field carrier, not strict versus relaxed wording.
A late negative control remains necessary so reduced packets do not teach the scorer to accept wrong-next movement.
avoid: Do not expose legal_successor_chunk_id before the final positive sanity control.
Do not treat PASS_CANDIDATE as actual advancement when the assistant visibly held.
Do not interpret label-only FAIL_LOST_ROUTE heuristic rows as language failures without manual review.
Do not clone the same negative-first order.
manual_next_study.suite_shape_recommendation: 18 cases, positive-first counterbalance. Cases 1-4 should test stripped carrier, wrong-next trap, route_id-only hold, and explicit active_chunk_id-only contrast. Cases 5-12 should run no-route/label/damaged probes. Cases 13-17 should repeat stripped carrier and key probes after negative exposure. Case 18 should be the explicit legal_successor sanity control.
manual_next_study.retirement_condition: Retire when we can state whether route_id + active_chunk_id advances from first position, whether negative-first guard priming suppresses that advancement, and whether no-route probes remain holds in both orders.
manual_next_study.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate a validator-ready route_law_order_context_counterbalance_v1 suite using the same schema, with positive stripped-carrier controls before any no-route negative probes.
manual_next_study.purpose: Run a positive-first counterbalance to determine whether route_id + active_chunk_id still advances when shown before missing-route guard probes, and whether negative-first framing suppresses the stripped carrier.

manual_notes.follow_up_repair_note: Current concern: messy tests pile up without enough reflection, planning, ownership of the next-test status, or cumulative analysis surface. Make the post-run digest mandatory before the next suite is designed.
manual_notes.ownership_rule: The design/review chat proposes the next study from the result; the import/tabulation/status layer records the current next-study pointer; fresh chats must read this status before creating new suites; completed manual next-study agendas must be explicitly retired before the next fresh-chat design cycle.
manual_notes.window_model: Design chat creates/reviews JSON, Casework GUI validates/runs setup, disposable ChatGPT test tab executes the runner.
manual_notes.cumulative_map_rule: One-off result reviews should guide the immediate next move, but every case should also append high-detail normalized data to a single case-law/rule-design matrix for later analysis.
manual_notes.legal_integration_rule: The Orion TTD legal system should stay woven into the test pipeline so results can be read through committed state, evidence, prose-as-claim, signals, smallest legal reduction, HOLD/REPAIR/REANCHOR, and PASS/FAIL route-survival language.
manual_notes.integration_simplification_question: As these parts are connected, decide whether each part should stay separate, collapse into another artifact, or be redesigned because it overlaps or adds too much maintenance. Keep pieces that reduce confusion; simplify anything that becomes a second source of truth.
manual_notes.rulebook_update_needed: Add a concise rule to ttdmobile_coding_rulebook.md so agents know how to use the reflection loop, cumulative case-law matrix, and legal-system test interpretation before modifying Casework study/status/review flows.

integration_open_question: Collapse or redesign overlapping artifacts if they become duplicate sources of truth.

resolved_findings.summary: Post-run follow-up is weak. Result JSON should be digested into Mermaid review, pass/failure summary, tool/scorer/language classification, an explicit next-study status update, and a cumulative case-law matrix append before any new suite is designed.
